activity.notes: After Manduul Khan's death, Mandukhai elevated the young Batumongke (Dayan Khan) and became the central queen-regent and military-political partner in the Northern Yuan reunification. ATLAS uses c.1479-c.1510 as a representative leadership window rather than claiming an uninterrupted formally defined regency with exact accession boundaries.

sources.title: Mandukhai
sources.citation_text: The biographical record identifies Mandukhai as Khatun of the Mongols/Northern Yuan and as the political partner who helped Dayan Khan reunite the Mongols, with her life ending in 1510.

sources.title: Northern Yuan dynasty — Restoration
sources.citation_text: The Northern Yuan historical sequence describes Mandukhai's elevation of Batumongke as Dayan Khan and their campaigns to restore central authority.
